title: MUSTER: source-adaptive retrieval and context assembly for agent memory
description: MUSTER derives a memory store's retrieval and rendering configuration from source structure. Version 1.0.0 adds source-derived fine retrieval, original-record restoration and first-ring context assembly. It extends the MacRAG fine-retrieval and context-expansion lineage to source-structured agent memory. Published answer-quality results retain their original implementation and SDK version. New assembly studies report evidence-recall and context diagnostics separately from generated-answer accuracy.
